body.en:
Definition / meaning

A plant utility is a supporting service or resource that enables process operation without necessarily becoming the main product.

Classification / comparison

  • Material services: water, air, gases; thermal services: steam, cooling/chilled water, refrigeration; power/support: electricity and safe disposal systems.

Labelled diagram

Plant utility roles

This is a concept chart;the detailed equipment sections appear under the relevant treatment topics below.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Water carries heat, dissolves materials, provides wash service and supplies steam systems; required quality differs for drinking, cooling, process and boiler use.
  • Steam transfers latent heat; electricity drives equipment; compressed air operates tools; instrument air serves controls; nitrogen provides designed inerting; refrigeration removes heat below the available sink temperature.
  • Selection starts with demand, quality, pressure/temperature and reliability, then life-cycle cost, water/energy use and safe disposal—not the lowest purchase price alone.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Plant utility એ મુખ્ય product પોતે ન હોવા છતાં manufacturing process ચલાવવા જરૂરી સહાયક service અથવા resource છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Material services: water, air, gases; thermal services: steam, cooling/chilled water, refrigeration; power/support: electricity તથા safe disposal.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Plant Utility નાં કાર્યો

આ concept chart છે;વિગતવાર equipmentની રચના તથા flow સંબંધિત treatment topicsમાં આપેલા છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • પાણી heat વહન, dissolving, washing તથા steam માટે વપરાય છે; drinking, cooling, process અને boiler માટે quality એકસરખી નથી.
  • Steam latent heat આપે, electricity equipment ચલાવે, compressed air tools માટે, instrument air controls માટે, nitrogen designed inerting માટે અને refrigeration નીચા temperature પર heat દૂર કરવા વપરાય છે.
  • પસંદગીમાં demand, quality, pressure/temperature, reliability પછી life-cycle cost, water-energy use અને safe disposal જુઓ; માત્ર ઓછી purchase price પૂરતી નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A water impurity is suspended, colloidal, dissolved or biological matter that changes suitability for the intended use.

Classification / comparison

  • Physical: suspended/colloidal; chemical: dissolved ions, gases, organics; biological: bacteria, viruses and other organisms.

Labelled diagram

Sources and contaminant barriers

This is a concept chart;the detailed equipment sections appear under the relevant treatment topics below.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Surface sources include rivers, lakes and reservoirs; groundwater includes wells/borewells; rainwater and treated reuse are possible with appropriate storage and treatment.
  • Groundwater often has more dissolved salts/hardness; surface water often varies in turbidity, microbes and organic load. These are tendencies, not a test certificate for any sample.
  • Suspended sand/silt can settle or filter; fine colloids may require coagulation; dissolved salts require chemical/membrane/ion-exchange methods; microbes require an effective disinfection barrier.
  • Dissolved oxygen/carbon dioxide affect corrosion; oil/organics can cause foaming/fouling. TDS, turbidity, pH, hardness and microbial quality measure different things.

વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

પાણીમાં suspended, colloidal, dissolved અથવા biological matter જે intended use માટે suitability બદલે તેને impurity કહેવાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Physical: suspended/colloidal; chemical: ions, gases, organics; biological: bacteria, virus તથા અન્ય organisms.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Sources તથા Contaminant Barriers

આ concept chart છે;વિગતવાર equipmentની રચના તથા flow સંબંધિત treatment topicsમાં આપેલા છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • River, lake/reservoir surface sources છે; well/borewell groundwater છે; યોગ્ય storage/treatment સાથે rainwater તથા treated reuse પણ શક્ય છે.
  • Groundwater માં ઘણીવાર salts/hardness વધારે અને surface water માં turbidity, microbes/organic load બદલાય છે; આ સામાન્ય વલણ છે, કોઈ sample નું પ્રમાણપત્ર નથી.
  • Sand/silt settling/filter થી દૂર થાય; colloids ને coagulation જોઈએ; dissolved salts ને chemical/membrane/ion-exchange અને microbes ને effective disinfection જોઈએ.
  • Dissolved oxygen/CO2 corrosion ને અસર કરે; oil/organics foaming/fouling કરે. TDS, turbidity, pH, hardness અને microbial quality જુદાં માપદંડ છે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Hardness is the soap-consuming and scale-forming tendency mainly associated with dissolved calcium and magnesium ions; soft water has relatively low hardness.

Classification / comparison

  • Carbonate/temporary versus noncarbonate/permanent; total hardness=calcium hardness+magnesium hardness on the same CaCO3basis.

Labelled diagram

Hardness versus total dissolved salts

This is a concept chart;the detailed equipment sections appear under the relevant treatment topics below.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Calcium/magnesium form insoluble soap salts, causing scum and extra soap consumption. Hard water can form scale in heated equipment, reduce heat transfer and obstruct flow.
  • Carbonate hardness is associated with alkalinity; in elementary treatment temporary hardness is commonly attributed to Ca/Mgbicarbonates. Noncarbonate/permanent hardness commonly comes from their sulphates, chlorides and nitrates.
  • Boiling can reduce some carbonate hardness but does not generally remove permanent hardness; magnesium chemistry and practical residuals require care.
  • Softened water can still contain sodium salts, microbes or corrosive dissolved gases. Soft, demineralized and potable are not synonyms.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Hardness મુખ્યત્વે dissolved calcium/magnesium ions થી થતી soap-consuming તથા scale-forming tendency છે; soft water માં hardness ઓછી હોય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Carbonate/temporary તથા noncarbonate/permanent; એક જ CaCO3 basis પર total hardness=Ca hardness+Mg hardness.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Hardness તથા TDS

આ concept chart છે;વિગતવાર equipmentની રચના તથા flow સંબંધિત treatment topicsમાં આપેલા છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Ca/Mg soap સાથે insoluble salts બનાવી scum તથા soap loss કરે; heated equipment માં scale, heat-transfer loss તથા flow obstruction થાય.
  • Carbonate hardness alkalinity સાથે સંબંધિત છે; basic treatment માં Ca/Mg bicarbonates temporary hardness આપે; તેમના sulphates/chlorides/nitrates noncarbonate/permanent hardness આપે છે.
  • Boiling થી કેટલીક carbonate hardness ઘટે છે, પણ permanent hardness સામાન્ય રીતે દૂર થતી નથી; Mg chemistry અને residuals ધ્યાનમાં લો.
  • Softened water માં sodium salts, microbes અથવા corrosive gases રહી શકે; soft, demineralized અને potable એક જ અર્થના શબ્દો નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Hardness concentration is commonly reported as milligrams per litre equivalent to CaCO3, allowing different hardness species to be compared on one chemical-equivalent basis.

Labelled diagram

Common CaCO3basis

This is a concept chart;the detailed equipment sections appear under the relevant treatment topics below.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • For dilute water, density near1kg/L makes mg/Lapproximately equal to ppm by mass; they are not universally identical units.
  • EDTAcomplexometric titration measures Ca/Mgunder the specified buffer, pH and indicator method. Ablank, standardisation and interfering ions affect accuracy.
  • Do not count NaClor every TDScomponent as hardness; use only the reported hardness-producing species and avoid counting an ion and its salt twice.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Equivalent mass of CaCO3=100/2=50g/equivalent using rounded classroom molar mass. For a species of molar mass Mwith hardness valence z, equivalent mass=M/z.
  2. Hardness as CaCO3=species concentration×50/(M/z). For Ca2+or Mg2+, this becomes concentration×100/M.
  3. If standardized EDTAfactor Fis mgCaCO3per mL, titrant volume Vminus blank Bfor sample S mLgives hardness=(V−B)F×1000/S mg/L.

Worked example

  1. Using Ca=40, Mg=24 for the stated example, Ca2+=40mg/L contributes100mg/L; Mg2+=24mg/L contributes100mg/L.Total=200mg/L as CaCO3.
  2. A50mLsample uses12mLEDTA, blank0.2mL, F=1mg/mL: hardness=(12−0.2)×1×1000/50=236mg/L as CaCO3.These are calculated data, not performed readings.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

જુદાં hardness species ને એક chemical-equivalent basis પર સરખાવવા hardness સામાન્ય રીતે mg/L as CaCO3 માં દર્શાવાય છે.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Common CaCO3 Basis

આ concept chart છે;વિગતવાર equipmentની રચના તથા flow સંબંધિત treatment topicsમાં આપેલા છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Dilute water ની density લગભગ 1kg/L હોય ત્યારે mg/L≈ppm by mass થાય; બંને હંમેશા એકસરખાં units નથી.
  • EDTA titration specified buffer, pH તથા indicator સાથે Ca/Mg માપે છે; blank, standardisation/interfering ions accuracy ને અસર કરે છે.
  • NaCl અથવા દરેક TDS component ને hardness ન ગણો; hardness-producing species જ લો અને ion તથા તેનું salt double count ન કરો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. Rounded classroom mass થી CaCO3 equivalent mass=100/2=50g/eq; species નું molar mass M/valence z હોય તો equivalent mass=M/z.
  2. Hardness as CaCO3=species concentration×50/(M/z); Ca2+/Mg2+ માટે concentration×100/M.
  3. EDTA factor F mgCaCO3/mL, volume V, blank B તથા sample S mL હોય તો hardness=(V−B)F×1000/S mg/L.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

  1. આ example માં Ca40/Mg24 લો: Ca2+40mg/L થી 100mg/L અને Mg2+24mg/L થી 100mg/L; total200mg/L as CaCO3.
  2. Sample50mL/EDTA12mL/blank0.2mL/F1 હોય તો 236mg/L as CaCO3; આ calculated example છે, actual readings નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Boiler feedwater is the water supplied to a boiler after treatment appropriate to its pressure, design and steam use; demineralized water has most dissolved mineral ions removed by a suitable process.

Labelled diagram

Boiler feedwater quality chain

This is a concept chart;the detailed equipment sections appear under the relevant treatment topics below.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Feedwater combines properly assessed makeup and returned condensate; returned condensate may carry process contamination and must not be assumed pure.
  • Hardness, silica, alkalinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, conductivity and organic contamination matter differently at different boiler pressures. No single universal acceptable feedwater table is invented here.
  • DMwater can absorb CO2and is not automatically sterile, potable or noncorrosive. Softening removes hardness but normally leaves total dissolved ionic material.

Working / process sequence

  1. Assess raw water and boiler requirement; remove suspended solids and hardness/minerals as needed.
  2. Control gases/chemistry with the approved deaeration and chemical programme; monitor feedwater/boiler water and blowdown.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Boiler feedwater એ boiler ની pressure/design/steam use મુજબ treat કરેલું supply water છે; demineralized water માંથી યોગ્ય process થી મોટા ભાગના mineral ions દૂર કરેલા હોય છે.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Boiler Feedwater Quality Chain

આ concept chart છે;વિગતવાર equipmentની રચના તથા flow સંબંધિત treatment topicsમાં આપેલા છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Feedwater માં treated makeup તથા assessed condensate return હોય; process-contaminated condensate ને શુદ્ધ માની ન લો.
  • Boiler pressure મુજબ hardness, silica, alkalinity, oxygen, pH, conductivity/organics નું મહત્વ બદલાય; એક universal limit table અહીં બનાવેલ નથી.
  • DM water CO2 absorb કરી શકે અને આપમેળે sterile/potable/noncorrosive નથી; softening hardness દૂર કરે પણ બીજા ions સામાન્ય રીતે રહે છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Raw water તથા boiler requirement જાણી solids/hardness/minerals નું જરૂરી treatment કરો.
  2. Approved deaeration/chemical programme થી gases/chemistry control કરી feedwater/boiler water તથા blowdown monitor કરો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Lime–soda softening converts dissolved hardness into separable CaCO3and Mg(OH)2precipitates by controlled addition of lime and soda ash.

Classification / comparison

  • Cold: near ambient designed conditions; hot: elevated treatment temperature. Exact temperature and residuals are process-specific, not universal guarantees.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Lime Ca(OH)2removes bicarbonate hardness and precipitates magnesium; Na2CO3removes calcium noncarbonate hardness, including calcium formed during magnesium treatment.
  • Ca(HCO3)2+Ca(OH)2→2CaCO3↓+2H2O; Mg(HCO3)2+2Ca(OH)2→Mg(OH)2↓+2CaCO3↓+2H2O.
  • MgSO4+Ca(OH)2→Mg(OH)2↓+CaSO4; CaSO4+Na2CO3→CaCO3↓+Na2SO4.Magnesium noncarbonate hardness therefore needs lime ANDsoda.
  • Hot treatment accelerates reaction, improves settling and can give lower residual hardness, while requiring heat/control. Cold treatment avoids heating but usually reacts/settles more slowly.

Labelled diagram

Cold lime–soda process: read the diagram

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Reagent feeds: lime slurry supplies Ca(OH)2; soda-ash solution supplies Na2CO3.The two lines enter the mixer; they are not the softened-water outlet.
  2. 2 Rapid mixer: incoming hard water and calculated reagents mix quickly so the chemicals distribute throughout the stream.
  3. 3 Flocculation/reaction chamber: gentler contact allows CaCO3 and Mg(OH)2 precipitates to aggregate into larger flocs.
  4. 4 Clarifier: the larger solids settle downward; the upper clarified stream leaves through the overflow arrangement toward the filter.
  5. 5 Sludge outlet: collected CaCO3/Mg(OH)2 solids leave separately. This branch is waste/sludge, not product water.
  6. 6 Filter and7 product: media captures residual suspended precipitate; the outlet is softened water whose residual hardness and pH still need checking.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Follow the blue path: hard water → mixer → flocculation → clarifier → filter → softened-water outlet. Orange arrows are chemical addition; brown is sludge removal.
  2. The main function is precipitation followed by physical separation. Chemical reaction alone does not remove the newly formed solids from the water.

Important limit: Cold means no separate feed-heating stage in this representative train. It does not mean zero residual hardness, complete DM water or drinking-water certification.

Labelled diagram

Hot lime–soda process: what heating changes

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Heater: the water-side and heat-side passages are shown separately. Steam/heat input raises feed temperature; its condensate/return is a different line from softened product.
  2. 2 Reagents: lime and soda are introduced under the approved hot-treatment conditions; heating does not replace reagent calculation.
  3. 3 Hot reaction/floc zone: higher temperature generally speeds the relevant reactions and assists formation of settleable solids.
  4. 4 Settling and5 sludge: precipitates settle; the lower branch removes solids while the clearer upper stream continues forward.
  5. 6 Filter and7 product: remaining suspended matter is filtered and the treated stream is checked against its actual next use.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Follow water through heating → hot mixing/reaction → settling → filtration. The extra operation compared with the cold train is controlled heating.
  2. Faster reaction/better settling may reduce residual hardness, but steam use, corrosion, pressure/temperature design and sludge handling still matter.

Important limit: This is one representative heated train, not a claim that every hot softener has separate vessels. Integrated atmospheric/pressurised arrangements differ; no operating temperature or valve sequence is prescribed.

Construction / parts

  1. Chemical preparation/dosing, rapid mixer, reaction/flocculation chamber, clarifier, sludge withdrawal and polishing filter are the principal blocks.
  2. Mixers distribute reagents; settling area separates precipitate; sludge removal prevents solids accumulation; filters catch carryover.

Working / process sequence

  1. Analyse hardness/alkalinity and interfering demand; calculate dose with stated purity.
  2. Dose lime/soda with controlled mixing and reaction conditions.
  3. Allow floc formation and settling; withdraw sludge and filter the clarified stream.
  4. Check residual hardness, pH and downstream suitability; manage sludge under approved practice.

Applications / uses

  • Large water-treatment loads where precipitation, clarification and sludge handling are justified.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Overdosing affects pH and carryover; under-dosing leaves hardness. Caustic lime/sludge handling is supervised; this is not a drinking-water home dosing recipe.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Controlled lime તથા soda ash ઉમેરવાથી dissolved hardness ને CaCO3/Mg(OH)2 precipitates માં ફેરવી અલગ કરવાની પ્રક્રિયા lime–soda softening છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Cold: ambient નજીક; hot: elevated treatment temperature; exact temperature/residual process-specific છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Ca(OH)2 bicarbonate hardness તથા Mg ને treat કરે; Na2CO3 noncarbonate Ca અને Mg treatment થી બનેલું Ca દૂર કરે.
  • Calcium bicarbonate માટે એક mole lime અને magnesium bicarbonate માટે બે mole lime જોઈએ; આ reactions માં CaCO3 તથા Mg(OH)2 precipitate બને છે.
  • MgSO4 lime થી Mg(OH)2 તથા CaSO4 બનાવે; પછી soda CaSO4 ને CaCO3 બનાવે; એટલે Mg noncarbonate hardness ને lime તથા soda બંને જોઈએ.
  • Hot process માં reaction/settling ઝડપી તથા residual hardness ઓછી થઈ શકે, પણ heat/control જોઈએ; cold માં heating નહીં પણ reaction/settling સામાન્ય રીતે ધીમું છે.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Cold Lime–Soda Process: Diagram પ્રમાણે સમજણ

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Reagent feeds: lime slurryમાંથી Ca(OH)2 અને soda-ash solutionમાંથી Na2CO3 મળે છે. બંને chemical lines mixerમાં જાય છે; તે softened-water outlet નથી.
  2. 2 Rapid mixer: આવતું hard water તથા ગણતરી મુજબના reagents ઝડપથી ભળે છે જેથી આખા streamમાં chemicals સમાન રીતે વહેંચાય.
  3. 3 Flocculation/reaction chamber: અહીં gentle mixingથી CaCO3 તથા Mg(OH)2નાં નાના precipitates ભેગાં થઈ મોટા flocs બનાવે છે.
  4. 4 Clarifier: મોટા solids નીચે settle થાય છે; ઉપરનું clarified water overflow arrangementથી filter તરફ જાય છે.
  5. 5 Sludge outlet: ભેગાં થયેલ CaCO3/Mg(OH)2 solids અલગ branchથી બહાર જાય છે. આ product water નહીં, sludge/waste branch છે.
  6. 6 Filter તથા7 product: media બાકી suspended precipitate પકડે છે; outlet softened water છે, તેની residual hardness તથા pH હજી ચકાસવાની રહે છે.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Blue path વાંચો: hard water → mixer → flocculation → clarifier → filter → softened-water outlet. Orange arrows chemicals અને brown arrow sludge બતાવે છે.
  2. મુખ્ય કાર્ય precipitation પછી physical separation છે. માત્ર reaction થવાથી બનેલા solids પાણીની બહાર આપમેળે નીકળી જતા નથી.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: આ representative cold trainમાં અલગ feed-heating stage નથી. તેનો અર્થ zero residual hardness, complete DM water કે potable certification નથી.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Hot Lime–Soda Process: Heatingથી શું બદલાય છે?

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Heater: water-side તથા heat-side paths અલગ બતાવ્યા છે. Steam/heatથી feedનું temperature વધે છે; તેનું condensate/return softened productથી અલગ છે.
  2. 2 Reagents: approved hot-treatment conditionsમાં lime તથા soda ઉમેરાય છે; heating reagent calculationનો વિકલ્પ નથી.
  3. 3 Hot reaction/floc zone: વધેલું temperature સામાન્ય રીતે reactions ઝડપી બનાવે અને settle થઈ શકે તેવા solids બનાવવામાં મદદ કરે છે.
  4. 4 Settling તથા5 sludge: precipitates નીચે settle થાય છે; નીચેની branch solids કાઢે અને ઉપરનું clearer water આગળ જાય છે.
  5. 6 Filter તથા7 product: બાકી suspended matter filter થાય છે અને treated stream તેની actual આગળની જરૂરિયાત સામે ચકાસાય છે.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Water flow વાંચો: heating → hot mixing/reaction → settling → filtration. Cold train કરતાં વધારાનું operation controlled heating છે.
  2. ઝડપી reaction/સારા settlingથી residual hardness ઘટી શકે, પણ steam use, corrosion, pressure-temperature design તથા sludge handling મહત્વનાં રહે છે.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: આ એક representative heated train છે; દર hot softenerમાં અલગ vessels જ હોય એવો દાવો નથી. Integrated atmospheric/pressurised designs જુદાં હોય છે; અહીં operating T કે valve sequence આપેલ નથી.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Chemical preparation/dosing, rapid mixer, reaction-flocculation, clarifier, sludge outlet તથા polishing filter મુખ્ય blocks છે.
  2. Mixer reagent વહેંચે, settling area precipitate અલગ કરે, sludge removal accumulation અટકાવે અને filter carryover પકડે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Hardness/alkalinity તથા extra demand જાણી stated purity થી dose ગણો.
  2. Controlled mixing/reaction સાથે lime/soda dose કરો.
  3. Floc બનવા દઈ settle કરો; sludge કાઢી clarified stream filter કરો.
  4. Residual hardness, pH તથા downstream suitability ચકાસી sludge નું approved management કરો.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Precipitation/clarification/sludge handling યોગ્ય હોય તેવા મોટા water-treatment loads.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Overdose થી pH/carryover અને underdose થી residual hardness; lime/sludge handling supervised રાખો, આ ઘરેલું drinking-water dosing recipe નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Zeolite softening exchanges sodium associated with a zeolitic exchanger for calcium/magnesium in water, removing hardness without removing all dissolved salts.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Na2Z+Ca2+→CaZ+2Na+; similarly Mg2+occupies exchange sites. The exchanger has finite capacity; hardness breakthrough indicates exhaustion.
  • Brine regenerates the sodium form through the designed equilibrium/excess-salt process; spent regenerant contains removed hardness and salt.
  • Turbidity can foul the bed; iron/manganese, acidic water and other contaminants need pretreatment compatible with exchanger type.

Labelled diagram

Zeolite softener: service and regeneration paths

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Inlet and distributor: pretreated hard water is spread over the exchange bed rather than channelled through one narrow path.
  2. 2 Sodium-form bed: Ca2+/Mg2+ replace exchangeable sodium at the zeolite sites. Na+ enters the treated water; hardness is reduced but all ions are not removed.
  3. 3 Underdrain: the support/collector allows liquid removal while retaining the bed material.
  4. 4 Service outlet: soft water is collected during normal operation; hardness monitoring detects exhaustion/breakthrough.
  5. 5 Brine tank: regenerant restores the sodium form under an approved regeneration procedure. This is the dashed orange feed, not an extra continuous raw-water source.
  6. 6 Waste/rinse: spent brine and rinse carry removed hardness/salt to controlled waste handling, not the product line.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Normal service follows solid blue arrows from inlet through bed/underdrain to product. At the prescribed exhaustion point, the unit changes to the alternative regeneration mode.
  2. After qualified regeneration and adequate rinse, quality is verified before service resumes. The drawing shows alternative routes together for study; it does not instruct simultaneous service and brining.

Important limit: Turbidity/oil/iron can foul the bed; the exact pretreatment depends on exchanger and feed. This is neither disinfection nor complete demineralization.

Construction / parts

  1. Vessel with distributor, exchange bed, support/underdrain, service/regeneration valves and brine system.

Working / process sequence

  1. Pretreated feed passes uniformly through the sodium-form bed.
  2. Ca/Mgare retained and sodium enters effluent; monitor hardness rather than TDSalone.
  3. At prescribed exhaustion, isolate/regenerate with controlled brine, then rinse to the approved quality before service.

Applications / uses

  • Hardness removal before suitable low-pressure boiler/process duties subject to full feedwater requirements.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Softening can increase sodium and does not disinfect or produce DMwater; regeneration waste requires controlled disposal.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Zeolitic exchanger ના sodium ની જગ્યાએ પાણીના Ca/Mg exchange કરી hardness દૂર કરવાની પ્રક્રિયા zeolite softening છે; બધા dissolved salts દૂર થતા નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Na2Z+Ca2+થી CaZ+2Na+ થાય; Mg પણ sites લે છે; capacity મર્યાદિત છે અને breakthrough exhaustion બતાવે છે.
  • Brine થી designed process માં sodium form પાછું મળે; spent regenerant માં hardness/salt જાય છે.
  • Turbidity bed foul કરે; Fe/Mn, acidic water તથા contaminants માટે compatible pretreatment જોઈએ.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Zeolite Softener: Service તથા Regeneration Paths

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Inlet/distributor: pretreated hard water exchange bed પર વહેંચાય છે જેથી માત્ર એક narrow channelમાંથી જ ન પસાર થાય.
  2. 2 Sodium-form bed: zeolite sitesના exchangeable sodiumની જગ્યાએ Ca2+/Mg2+ આવે છે. Na+ treated waterમાં જાય છે; hardness ઘટે છે, બધા ions દૂર થતા નથી.
  3. 3 Underdrain: support/collector liquid બહાર જવા દે છે અને bed materialને vesselમાં રાખે છે.
  4. 4 Service outlet: normal operationમાં soft water collect થાય છે; hardness monitoringથી exhaustion/breakthrough ખબર પડે છે.
  5. 5 Brine tank: approved regenerationથી sodium form પાછું મળે છે. Dashed orange line regenerant feed છે, continuous raw-water source નહીં.
  6. 6 Waste/rinse: spent brine તથા rinse removed hardness/saltને controlled waste તરફ લઈ જાય છે, product lineમાં નહીં.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Normal serviceમાં blue arrows મુજબ inlet → bed → underdrain → product જાય છે. Prescribed exhaustion પછી alternative regeneration mode લેવાય છે.
  2. Qualified regeneration તથા પૂરતા rinse પછી quality verify કરીને service શરૂ થાય છે. Diagramમાં routes અભ્યાસ માટે સાથે બતાવ્યા છે; service તથા brining એક સાથે કરવાની સૂચના નથી.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Turbidity/oil/iron bed foul કરી શકે; pretreatment feed/exchanger મુજબ છે. આ disinfection કે complete DM process નથી.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Vessel, distributor, exchange bed, support-underdrain, service-regeneration valves તથા brine system.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Pretreated feed sodium-bed માં uniformly પસાર થાય.
  2. Ca/Mg bed માં રહી sodium effluent માં આવે; માત્ર TDS નહીં, hardness monitor કરો.
  3. Prescribed exhaustion પર isolate/brine-regenerate કરો; approved quality સુધી rinse કરીને service માં લો.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Full feedwater requirement સાથે યોગ્ય boiler/process duties માં hardness removal.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Sodium વધી શકે; disinfection કે DM production થતું નથી; regeneration waste નું controlled disposal જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Demineralization by ion exchange replaces dissolved cations with H+and anions with OH−so the released ions combine to form water.

Classification / comparison

  • Cation/anion units in series; optional degassing and mixed bed. Sodium-cycle softening is also ion exchange but is not H/OHdemineralization.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • 2RH+Ca2+→R2Ca+2H+; ROH+Cl−→RCl+OH−; H++OH−→H2O.These are schematic resin-site reactions.
  • Adegasser may remove CO2between suitable stages; mixed-bed polishing can improve final ionic purity. Degassing alone does not remove every dissolved ion.
  • Conductivity monitors ionic leakage, but low conductivity alone does not certify absence of silica, organics or microbes for every use.

Labelled diagram

Ion-exchange DM: follow ions and the water path

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Feed: previously clarified/suitable feed enters the cation exchanger. Pretreatment protects the resin from solids and incompatible contaminants.
  2. 2 H-form cation resin: metal/sodium cations exchange for H+.This can turn dissolved salts into corresponding acids in the intermediate stream.
  3. 3 Optional degasser: air contact/packing removes suitable CO2 load where designed. Air and vent arrows are not the final DM-product path.
  4. 4 OH-form anion resin: anions exchange for OH−; H+ and OH− combine to water. The ability to remove silica depends on resin/system design.
  5. 5 DM outlet: product is assessed by appropriate conductivity/other quality tests. Most mineral ions are removed; sterility is not guaranteed.
  6. 6 Separate regeneration wastes: acid and alkali paths belong to qualified regeneration/rinsing. Corrosive chemicals and wastes are not crossed or mixed casually.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Follow the solid water path: cation bed → optional degasser → anion bed → product. The drawn downflow through each bed is a representative service arrangement.
  2. Regeneration restores exhausted resin capacity; it is an alternative controlled mode, not part of the simultaneous product flow shown by the blue arrows.

Important limit: Sodium-cycle softening is also ion exchange but leaves sodium salts; do not identify it with the H/OH demineralization train. Degassing alone does not remove every ion.

Construction / parts

  1. Separate resin vessels/distributors, regeneration systems, rinse lines, instrumentation and compatible waste-neutralisation facilities.

Working / process sequence

  1. Pass pretreated water through H-form cation resin, then suitable anion removal stage.
  2. Monitor product quality and stop/regenerate at the prescribed endpoint rather than waiting for visible dirt.
  3. Qualified operators regenerate cation/anion resins with approved acid/alkali procedures, separate incompatible chemicals and rinse completely.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Regenerants are corrosive; no student acid/alkali dosing instruction is given. Resin fouling, pressure loss and waste handling add cost.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Ion-exchange DM માં cations ની જગ્યાએ H+ તથા anions ની જગ્યાએ OH− આવે છે; પછી H+/OH− મળીને water બનાવે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Series cation/anion units, optional degassing/mixed bed; sodium-cycle softening પણ exchange છે પણ H/OH DM નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Cation resin Ca સામે H+ આપે; anion resin Cl સામે OH− આપે; H++OH−→H2O; આ schematic resin-site reactions છે.
  • Suitable stages વચ્ચે degasser CO2 દૂર કરે; mixed-bed polishing ionic purity સુધારે; degassing બધા ions દૂર નથી કરતું.
  • Conductivity ionic leakage બતાવે, પણ low conductivity થી દરેક use માટે silica/organics/microbes absent સાબિત નથી થતા.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Ion-exchange DM: Ions તથા Water Path પ્રમાણે સમજણ

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Feed: clarified/suitable feed cation exchangerમાં જાય છે. Pretreatment resinને solids તથા incompatible contaminantsથી બચાવે છે.
  2. 2 H-form cation resin: metal/sodium cationsની જગ્યાએ H+ મળે છે; intermediate streamમાં salts સંબંધિત acidsરૂપે થઈ શકે છે.
  3. 3 Optional degasser: designed air-contact/packingથી યોગ્ય CO2 load દૂર થાય છે. Air/vent arrows final DM-product path નથી.
  4. 4 OH-form anion resin: anionsની જગ્યાએ OH− મળે અને H+/OH− મળીને water બને છે. Silica removal resin/system design પર આધારિત છે.
  5. 5 DM outlet: conductivity તથા અન્ય જરૂરી testsથી quality assess થાય છે. મોટા ભાગના mineral ions દૂર થાય, પણ sterility guarantee નથી.
  6. 6 Separate wastes: acid/alkali paths qualified regeneration/rinse માટે છે. Corrosive chemicals તથા wastesને casually cross/mix ન કરવા.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Solid water path વાંચો: cation bed → optional degasser → anion bed → product. દર bedમાં downflow એક representative service arrangement છે.
  2. Regeneration exhausted resinની capacity પાછી લાવે છે; તે blue product flow સાથે એકસાથે ચાલતો mode નહીં, alternative controlled mode છે.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Sodium softening પણ exchange છે પણ sodium salts રહે છે; તેને H/OH DM સાથે સમાન ન ગણો. Degassing પોતે બધા ions દૂર નથી કરતું.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Separate resin vessels/distributors, regeneration/rinse lines, instrumentation તથા compatible waste-neutralisation.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Pretreated water H-form cation પછી suitable anion stage માં મોકલો.
  2. Product quality monitor કરો; visible dirt ની રાહ નહીં, endpoint પર regenerate કરો.
  3. Qualified operators approved acid/alkali procedure થી regenerate કરે; incompatible chemicals અલગ રાખી સંપૂર્ણ rinse કરે.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Regenerants corrosive છે; student acid/alkali dosing instructions નથી; fouling, pressure loss તથા waste થી cost વધે.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Phosphate conditioning is an internal boiler-water treatment that controls suitable calcium precipitation/chemistry under a pressure-specific programme; it is not a universal replacement for external water softening.

Labelled diagram

Phosphate conditioning: inside the boiler-water system

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Solution tank: holds the approved conditioning chemical; its purpose is treatment control, not storage of product softened water.
  2. 2 Metering arrangement: qualified dosing introduces a controlled amount at the approved point; the diagram provides no numerical dose.
  3. 3 Feed/dosing point: the line carries conditioned feed toward the boiler; the correct injection point depends on the plant programme.
  4. 4 Boiler water: phosphate helps control calcium precipitation under suitable chemistry. Suspended solids are kept manageable rather than allowed to become adherent scale.
  5. 5 Steam space/outlet: steam separates above the water level; sludge is not intended to leave with this product stream.
  6. 6 Blowdown/sludge branch: the approved programme removes concentrated water/solids through a distinct controlled path.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Read the drawing as chemical addition → controlled in-boiler chemistry → monitoring/solids removal, not as a stand-alone external raw-water softener.
  2. External treatment, deaeration, internal chemistry and blowdown complement one another; phosphate overdosing cannot replace them indiscriminately.

Important limit: All pressure parts and hot-water/steam paths are conceptual. No opening, chemical dosing or blowdown operation by students is authorised.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • An elementary representation is3Ca2++2PO4^3−→Ca3(PO4)2↓.Actual boiler precipitate chemistry can include hydroxyapatite and depends on pH/conditions.
  • Correct conditioning favours removable sludge rather than adherent scale; blowdown and sludge control are essential. Phosphate hideout/concentration effects matter in suitable higher-pressure systems.

Working / process sequence

  1. Set the programme from feedwater analysis and boiler/OEMrequirements.
  2. Qualified dosing, water analysis and controlled blowdown maintain the specified chemistry and remove solids.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • No universal phosphate dose or pHtarget is safe for every boiler; overdosing cannot correct inadequate makeup treatment indefinitely.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Phosphate conditioning એ pressure-specific programme હેઠળ boiler ની અંદર calcium precipitation/chemistry control કરતું treatment છે; external softening નો universal વિકલ્પ નથી.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Phosphate Conditioning: Boiler-water Systemની અંદર

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Solution tank: approved conditioning chemical રાખે છે; આ treatment control માટે છે, softened product water માટે નહીં.
  2. 2 Metering arrangement: approved point પર qualified dosingથી controlled amount જાય છે; diagram કોઈ dose આપતો નથી.
  3. 3 Feed/dosing point: conditioned feed boiler તરફ જાય છે; actual injection point plant programme પ્રમાણે છે.
  4. 4 Boiler water: suitable chemistryમાં phosphate calcium precipitation control કરે; solidsને manageable રાખવામાં મદદ કરે જેથી adherent scale ન બને.
  5. 5 Steam space/outlet: waterની ઉપર steam અલગ થાય છે; sludge આ product stream સાથે જવું intended નથી.
  6. 6 Blowdown/sludge branch: approved programmeથી concentrated water/solids અલગ controlled pathથી દૂર થાય છે.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Drawingનો અર્થ chemical addition → controlled boiler chemistry → monitoring/solids removal છે; stand-alone external raw-water softener નહીં.
  2. External treatment, deaeration, internal chemistry તથા blowdown complementary છે; phosphate overdoseથી બધાને બદલી શકાતાં નથી.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Pressure parts/hot-water/steam paths conceptual છે; student opening, dosing કે blowdown operation authorised નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Basic representation3Ca2++2PO4^3−→Ca3(PO4)2 છે; actual boiler માં hydroxyapatite વગેરે pH/conditions મુજબ બને છે.
  • યોગ્ય conditioning adherent scale ની જગ્યાએ removable sludge બનાવવામાં મદદ કરે; blowdown/sludge control જરૂરી છે; કેટલાક high-pressure systems માં hideout/concentration મહત્વનું છે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Feedwater analysis તથા boiler/OEM requirement થી programme નક્કી કરો.
  2. Qualified dosing, analysis/blowdown થી specified chemistry જાળવી solids કાઢો.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • દરેક boiler માટે universal dose/pH safe નથી; અયોગ્ય makeup treatment ને overdose થી સતત સુધારી શકાતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Potable water is water meeting applicable microbiological, chemical, physical and acceptability requirements for human consumption; clear appearance alone does not establish safety.

Labelled diagram

Potable-water assessment

This is a concept chart;the detailed equipment sections appear under the relevant treatment topics below.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Assess colour, odour, taste, turbidity, pH, dissolved chemicals and microbial indicators through the applicable standard and accredited methods.
  • Health-related limits and acceptability criteria are not interchangeable; local/current drinking-water standards govern rather than a textbook adjective such as “pure”.
  • Low TDSdoes not prove disinfection, and higher TDSdoes not identify which ions are present.pHis logarithmic and cannot be inferred reliably from colour or taste.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

માનવ ઉપયોગ માટે applicable microbial, chemical, physical તથા acceptability requirements પૂરી કરતું પાણી potable છે; માત્ર ચોખ્ખું દેખાવું safety સાબિત નથી કરતું.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Potable-water Assessment

આ concept chart છે;વિગતવાર equipmentની રચના તથા flow સંબંધિત treatment topicsમાં આપેલા છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Colour, odour, taste, turbidity, pH, chemicals તથા microbial indicators ને applicable standard/method થી ચકાસો.
  • Health limits તથા acceptability criteria જુદાં છે; “pure” શબ્દ નહીં, applicable current standard અનુસરો.
  • Low TDS થી disinfection સાબિત નહીં; TDS વધુ હોય તો કયા ions છે તે ખબર નહીં; pH logarithmic છે અને taste/colour થી વિશ્વસનીય રીતે નક્કી નહીં થાય.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Water purification combines barriers selected to remove the actual contaminants; physical clarification is not by itself complete microbial disinfection or desalination.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Screening intercepts large debris. Sedimentation separates settleable solids by gravity; fine stable colloids may remain.
  • Coagulation destabilises colloids through controlled chemical addition/rapid mixing; flocculation gently promotes larger flocs. Settling then removes the flocs.
  • Granular filtration removes particles through capture mechanisms in a designed bed, not simply by sieving every particle larger than a sand grain. Backwashing restores hydraulic capacity as designed.
  • Slow-sand and rapid filters differ in loading, pretreatment, biological contribution and cleaning; one description cannot be copied unchanged to both.

Labelled diagram

Overall purification: why several barriers are drawn

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Screen removes coarse debris, not dissolved salts.
  2. 2 Rapid mixing/coagulation destabilises colloids; 3 gentle flocculation grows aggregates.
  3. 4 Settling separates suitable flocs downward and sends clarified water to5 filtration.
  4. 5 Filter captures remaining particles; its collected effluent goes to6 validated disinfection/contact.
  5. 7 Protected storage/distribution prevents treated water being contaminated again after the preceding barriers.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Read the top row left-to-right through1→4, then the return row through5→6→7.Directions bend because the drawing saves space, not because water reverses every treatment step.
  2. Each stage has a different target; no single screen, sand bed or disinfectant should be credited with every removal mechanism.

Important limit: This is a representative sequence. Selected barriers/order depend on raw water and intended use; desalination/softening may require additional separate processes.

Construction / parts

  1. Screen/intake, raw-water feed, rapid mixer, flocculator, clarifier, filter with underdrains and separate disinfection/contact storage.

Working / process sequence

  1. Choose treatment from raw-water tests; remove gross debris first.
  2. Where necessary, coagulate/flocculate at validated dose/mixing conditions and settle.
  3. Filter clarified water, monitor turbidity/head loss and clean using the designed method.
  4. Apply validated disinfection and protect treated storage/distribution against recontamination.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Astudent sand/charcoal bottle model is not proof that the effluent is drinkable; do not taste or distribute model-treated water.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Actual contaminants મુજબ પસંદ કરેલા barriers થી water purification થાય; physical clarification પોતે સંપૂર્ણ disinfection કે desalination નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Screening મોટા debris અટકાવે; sedimentation gravity થી settleable solids અલગ કરે; fine colloids રહી શકે.
  • Coagulation controlled reagent/rapid mixing થી colloids destabilise કરે; flocculation gentle mixing થી મોટા flocs બનાવે; પછી settling થાય.
  • Granular bed માં capture થી particles દૂર થાય; માત્ર sand grain થી મોટા particles નું sieving નથી; designed backwash hydraulic capacity પાછી લાવે.
  • Slow-sand/rapid filters માં loading, pretreatment, biological action તથા cleaning જુદાં છે.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Overall Purification: એકથી વધુ Barriers કેમ?

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Screen coarse debris દૂર કરે, dissolved salts નહીં.
  2. 2 Rapid mixing/coagulation colloids destabilise કરે; 3 gentle flocculation aggregates વધારે.
  3. 4 Settling suitable flocs નીચે અલગ કરી clarified waterને5 filtration તરફ મોકલે.
  4. 5 Filter બાકી particles પકડે; collected effluent6 validated disinfection/contactમાં જાય.
  5. 7 Protected storage/distribution અગાઉના treatment પછી recontamination અટકાવે છે.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Top row1→4 ડાબેથી જમણે અને return row5→6→7 વાંચો. Space માટે path વળે છે; process steps ઉલટાં નથી થતાં.
  2. દરેક stageનું target જુદું છે; એક screen, sand bed કે disinfectantને તમામ removal mechanismsનો credit ન આપો.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: આ representative sequence છે; raw water/use મુજબ barriers/order બદલાય; softening/desalination માટે અલગ processes જોઈએ.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Screen/intake, raw feed, rapid mixer, flocculator, clarifier, underdrain વાળું filter તથા separate disinfection/contact storage.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Raw-water test થી treatment પસંદ કરી પહેલાં debris દૂર કરો.
  2. જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં validated dose/mixing થી coagulate/flocculate કરી settle કરો.
  3. Clarified water filter કરી turbidity/head loss monitor તથા designed cleaning કરો.
  4. Validated disinfection કરીને storage/distribution ને recontamination થી બચાવો.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Student sand/charcoal bottle model નું પાણી potable સાબિત નથી; taste કે distribute ન કરો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Disinfection reduces/inactivates target pathogens under validated conditions; the syllabus term sterilization should not be read as a guarantee of absolute sterility in routine water treatment.

Classification / comparison

  • Free-chlorine methods: chlorine/available chlorine compounds; combined-chlorine methods: controlled chloramination.

Labelled diagram

Chemical disinfection: contact before verification

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Approved supply/metering delivers the selected disinfectant under qualified control. The symbol is generic for an appropriate engineered feed system, not a chlorine-generation recipe.
  2. 2 Clarified/filtered inlet reduces some shielding/demand issues; quality still determines required treatment.
  3. 3 Baffled tank promotes contact and limits a direct short-circuit path; actual effective contact time depends on hydraulics/validation.
  4. 4 Sampling verifies the appropriate residual after the required contact conditions; dose, demand and residual are not the same value.
  5. 5 Outlet/storage is protected against recontamination; meeting a residual target alone does not replace all quality checks.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Follow water into the contactor after the controlled addition point, then to sampling/protected storage. The baffles lengthen the conceptual path; they do not make contact time infinite.
  2. Chlorine, bleaching-powder available chlorine and controlled chloramine systems need different feed chemistry even when this general contact/monitoring layout is applicable.

Important limit: Never mix bleach with acid, ammonia or cleaners; chloramine treatment is not a safe home mixing experiment. The source term sterilization is taught as validated disinfection, not guaranteed absolute sterility.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Chlorine in water forms species including HOCl/OCl−; pHchanges their proportions and disinfection effectiveness. Dose, contact time, temperature, turbidity and demand matter.
  • Bleaching powder supplies available chlorine but actual strength falls with ageing/storage; nominal powder mass is not the same as active chlorine mass.
  • Chloramines are combined-chlorine disinfectants, often more persistent but slower for many targets than free chlorine. They require controlled chemistry and may create nitrification/other operational issues.
  • Chlorine demand is consumption by the water; residual remains after demand and contact conditions. The simple relation dose≈demand+specified residual is a bookkeeping example, not a complete dosing design.

Worked example

  1. Hypothetical demand1.5mg/Land target residual0.5mg/Lgive dose2mg/L.For10m3, active chlorine mass=2×10=20g. If actual available chlorine is25%, powder equivalent=20/0.25=80g. This is arithmetic only, not field guidance.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Never mix bleach with acid, ammonia or other cleaners. No student chlorine-gas generation or homemade chloramine preparation is authorised; qualified operators verify residual/contact time and by-products.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Disinfection validated conditions માં target pathogens ઘટાડે/inactivate કરે; syllabus ના sterilization શબ્દને routine water treatment માં absolute sterility guarantee ન માનો.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Free chlorine: chlorine/available-chlorine compounds; combined chlorine: controlled chloramination.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Chemical Disinfection: Contact પછી Verification

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Approved supply/metering qualified control હેઠળ selected disinfectant આપે; આ generic engineered feed છે, chlorine-generation recipe નહીં.
  2. 2 Clarified/filtered inletથી કેટલીક shielding/demand સમસ્યા ઘટે, પણ actual qualityથી treatment નક્કી થાય છે.
  3. 3 Baffles contact વધારે તથા short-circuit ઘટાડે; effective contact time actual hydraulics/validationથી નક્કી થાય છે.
  4. 4 Samplingથી required contact પછી residual ચકાસાય; dose, demand તથા residual એક value નથી.
  5. 5 Outlet/storageને recontaminationથી બચાવો; માત્ર residual targetથી બધી quality checks replace નથી થતી.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Controlled addition પછી water contactorમાં અને પછી sampling/protected storageમાં જાય છે. Baffles path વધારે છે, contact time infinite નથી કરતી.
  2. General contact/monitoring layout લાગુ પડે ત્યારે પણ chlorine, bleaching powder તથા controlled chloramineની feed chemistry જુદી હોય છે.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Bleach સાથે acid, ammonia/cleaner ન મિક્સ કરો; chloramine treatment ઘરેલું mixing experiment નથી. Sourceનું sterilization અહીં validated disinfection છે, absolute sterility guarantee નહીં.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Chlorine થી HOCl/OCl− બને; pH પ્રમાણે ratio/effectiveness બદલાય; dose, contact time, T, turbidity/demand મહત્વનાં છે.
  • Bleaching powder available chlorine આપે; age/storage થી strength ઘટે; powder mass તથા active chlorine mass એક નથી.
  • Chloramines combined chlorine છે; ઘણીવાર વધુ persistent પણ અનેક targets માટે slower છે; controlled chemistry જોઈએ અને nitrification/operating issues થઈ શકે.
  • Demand એટલે water દ્વારા chlorine consumption; residual બાકી રહે; dose≈demand+residual માત્ર basic bookkeeping છે, complete dosing design નહીં.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

  1. Hypothetical demand1.5/residual0.5 થી dose2mg/L; 10m3 માટે active chlorine20g; actual strength25% હોય તો powder-equivalent80g; આ માત્ર arithmetic છે, field guidance નથી.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Bleach ને acid, ammonia/cleaner સાથે ન મિક્સ કરો; student chlorine gas/homemade chloramine preparation નહીં; qualified operators residual/contact/by-products ચકાસે.

title.gu: UV તથા Ozone: Green Technique નો વ્યાપ

h.gu: UV તથા Ozone: Green Technique નો વ્યાપ

body.en:
Definition / meaning

UVdisinfection uses germicidal radiation to damage microbial genetic material; ozonation uses a powerful oxidant to inactivate organisms and oxidise selected contaminants.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • UVperformance depends on delivered dose, UVtransmittance, flow, particle shielding and lamp condition. UVdoes not normally provide a lasting distribution residual or remove dissolved salts.
  • Ozone is generated on site, contacted with water and followed by off-gas treatment. It can form by-products such as bromate when relevant precursors/conditions exist.
  • Both can reduce certain chemical-storage burdens but use energy and require maintenance, exposure protection and validated performance.“Green”does not mean impact-free or automatically best.

Labelled diagram

UV reactor: water path around an enclosed source

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Pretreated inlet supplies water with suitable UV transmittance/clarity for the validated reactor.
  2. 2 Enclosure contains the water and germicidal source; the drawing does not instruct opening it while energised.
  3. 3 Lamp/quartz sleeve: the sleeve separates the lamp arrangement from flowing water while permitting the designed radiation transfer; fouling reduces useful transmission.
  4. 4 Sensor/status monitoring checks relevant intensity/conditions; proper alarm/flow response belongs to the validated system design.
  5. 5 Outlet must remain protected because UV normally leaves no durable distribution disinfectant residual.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Water follows the blue arrows through the irradiated zone; the purple rays show the enclosed treatment region, not safe rays for direct human viewing.
  2. Delivered dose depends on effective intensity and exposure distribution/flow, not just the presence of a lit lamp. Shadowing and dirty sleeves can defeat an otherwise powered unit.

Important limit: No exposed UV viewing or student irradiation trial is proposed. UV does not soften or demineralize the water.

Labelled diagram

Ozonation: gas and water move on different paths

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Feed/generator makes ozone on site in controlled equipment from the designed dry gas source; it is not an open demonstration device.
  2. 2 Contactor holds the gas–water treatment region; the drawn water inlet is higher than the treated-water outlet in this representative countercurrent concept.
  3. 3 Off-gas treatment receives untransferred gas above the liquid and destroys/handles it before the specified safe vent route.
  4. 4 Diffuser spreads ozone-containing gas as bubbles; transfer/contact conditions influence the delivered treatment.
  5. 5 Outlet water goes to suitable downstream protection/monitoring; ozone does not provide the durable residual of a correctly designed residual-disinfectant system.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Follow purple gas from generator to bottom diffuser, up as bubbles and out through off-gas destruction. Follow blue water separately from inlet to outlet.
  2. Ozone inactivates/oxidises under validated conditions; source-water chemistry may also allow by-products, so contact and quality monitoring are essential.

Important limit: Ozone is harmful to breathe. No student ozone generation, leak test or contact-vessel operation is authorised.

Construction / parts

  1. UV: enclosed reactor, lamps/sleeves, flow and intensity monitoring; ozone: generator, gas feed, contactor, monitoring and off-gas destruct unit.

Working / process sequence

  1. Pretreat to suitable clarity and select the validated target/dose/contact conditions.
  2. Deliver controlled UVor ozone contact and monitor failure/flow quality; protect downstream storage from recontamination.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • No exposed UVlamp viewing and no student ozone generation/inhalation. Chemical-free appearance does not establish microbial safety.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

UV germicidal radiation થી microbial genetic material ને નુકસાન કરે; ozone strong oxidant તરીકે organisms inactivate તથા selected contaminants oxidise કરે છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • UV dose, transmittance, flow, particle shielding/lamp condition મહત્વનાં છે; UV સામાન્ય રીતે lasting residual આપતું કે salts દૂર કરતું નથી.
  • Ozone on-site generate કરી water contact કરાય તથા off-gas treat થાય; relevant bromide/conditions માં bromate જેવા by-products બની શકે.
  • બંનેમાં કેટલીક chemical-storage જરૂરિયાત ઘટે, પણ energy, maintenance, exposure protection/validation જોઈએ; green એટલે impact-free કે હંમેશા best નહીં.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

UV Reactor: Enclosed Sourceની આસપાસ Water Path

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Pretreated inlet validated reactor માટે suitable UV transmittance/clarityવાળું water આપે છે.
  2. 2 Enclosure water તથા germicidal sourceને અંદર રાખે છે; energised હોય ત્યારે ખોલવાની સૂચના નથી.
  3. 3 Lamp/quartz sleeve lampને flowing waterથી અલગ રાખી designed radiation પસાર થવા દે; foulingથી transmission ઘટે છે.
  4. 4 Sensor/status relevant intensity/conditions ચકાસે; alarm/flow response validated system મુજબ હોય છે.
  5. 5 Outletને સુરક્ષિત રાખવો જરૂરી છે, કારણ કે UV સામાન્ય રીતે durable distribution residual આપતું નથી.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Water blue arrows મુજબ irradiated zoneમાંથી જાય; purple rays enclosed treatment બતાવે છે, માનવ સીધું જોઈ શકે એવી safe rays નહીં.
  2. Dose effective intensity તથા exposure/flow પર આધારિત છે, માત્ર lamp ચાલુ હોવા પર નહીં. Shadowing/dirty sleeveથી powered unit પણ inadequate થઈ શકે.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Exposed UV જોવું કે student irradiation trial સૂચવેલ નથી. UV softening/DM નથી કરતું.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Ozonation: Gas તથા Waterના જુદા Paths

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Feed/generator designed dry gasમાંથી controlled equipmentમાં ozone બનાવે છે; open demo device નથી.
  2. 2 Contactor gas-water contact માટે છે; આ representative countercurrent drawingમાં water inlet ઊંચું અને outlet નીચે બતાવ્યું છે.
  3. 3 Off-gas treatment liquid ઉપરનો untransferred gas લઈ safe vent પહેલાં તેને destroy/handle કરે છે.
  4. 4 Diffuser ozoneવાળો gas bubblesરૂપે વહેંચે; transfer/contact conditions actual treatmentને અસર કરે છે.
  5. 5 Outlet water યોગ્ય downstream protection/monitoringમાં જાય; ozone durable distribution residualનો વિકલ્પ નથી.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Purple gas generatorથી bottom diffuser, પછી bubblesરૂપે ઉપર અને off-gas destruct તરફ જાય; blue water inletથી outlet જુદે વાંચો.
  2. Validated conditionsમાં ozone inactivate/oxidise કરે; source chemistryથી by-products પણ થઈ શકે, એટલે monitoring જરૂરી છે.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Ozone શ્વાસમાં લેવો હાનિકારક છે. Student generation, leak test કે contact-vessel operation authorised નથી.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. UV: enclosed reactor, lamps/sleeves, flow-intensity monitor; ozone: generator, gas feed, contactor, monitor/off-gas destruct.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Suitable clarity માટે pretreat કરી validated target/dose/contact પસંદ કરો.
  2. Controlled UV/ozone આપી failure/flow-quality monitor કરો; downstream storage ને recontamination થી બચાવો.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Exposed UV lamp ન જુઓ; student ozone generation/inhalation નહીં; chemical-free દેખાવથી microbial safety સાબિત નથી થતી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Boiler-water trouble is damage or loss of reliable steam generation caused by unsuitable feedwater/chemistry, solids or carryover under operating conditions.

Classification / comparison

  • Deposition: scale/sludge; metal loss: corrosion; steam contamination: priming/foaming; stress-related cracking: caustic embrittlement.

Labelled diagram

Four trouble sketches: match mechanism to prevention

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Scale: the deposited layer lies between hot metal and the water passage, increasing thermal resistance and risking metal overheating.
  2. 2 Corrosion: local pits indicate metal loss by chemical/electrochemical attack rather than an added insulating layer.
  3. 3 Priming/foaming: the steam outlet can entrain liquid droplets when level/load/foam conditions promote carryover; foam bubbles are not pure steam quality control.
  4. 4 Caustic-related cracking: local concentration plus susceptible stress/material conditions can produce cracks; this differs from uniform metal loss or ordinary scale.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Diagnose deposition, metal loss, carryover or cracking before choosing treatment. One chemical cannot be assumed to cure all four mechanisms.
  2. Use the appropriate combination of external treatment, deaeration/internal chemistry, level/load control, blowdown and qualified inspection.

Important limit: The sections are explanatory, not failure-analysis proof of a real boiler. No opening, chemical cleaning or pressure-part repair is proposed.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Scale is adherent deposition on heating surfaces; sludge is more readily removable loose matter. Scale reduces heat transfer and can cause metal overheating. External treatment, internal conditioning and controlled blowdown are complementary.
  • Corrosion is material degradation by chemical/electrochemical interaction. Oxygen pitting and CO2-related condensate corrosion require gas/chemistry control and suitable monitoring/material practice.
  • Priming is water-droplet entrainment with steam; foaming is persistent bubble/froth formation that promotes carryover. High level, rapid load changes, high dissolved solids and oil can contribute. Control load/level, chemistry and separation.
  • Caustic embrittlement is caustic-related stress corrosion cracking under susceptible stressed/concentrating conditions, not simply “all alkaline water attacks all steel”.Avoid local concentration and use a qualified chemistry programme.

Applications / uses

  • Diagnose the mechanism before choosing pretreatment, deaeration, conditioning, blowdown or maintenance action.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Do not open a pressurised boiler, adjust safety devices or perform unsupervised chemical cleaning. Examples are study guides, not operating authorisation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Feedwater/chemistry, solids અથવા carryover ને કારણે damage કે unreliable steam generation થાય તેને boiler-water trouble કહેવાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Deposition: scale/sludge; metal loss: corrosion; steam contamination: priming/foaming; stress-related cracking: caustic embrittlement.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

ચાર Trouble Sketches: Mechanism મુજબ Prevention

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Scale: hot metal તથા water વચ્ચે deposit layer thermal resistance વધારે અને metal overheatingનું જોખમ ઊભું કરે છે.
  2. 2 Corrosion: pits chemical/electrochemical attackથી metal loss છે, ઉમેરાયેલ insulating layer નહીં.
  3. 3 Priming/foaming: level/load/foamથી carryover વધે તો outlet steam સાથે liquid droplets જાય; foam bubbles quality control નથી.
  4. 4 Caustic cracking: local concentration તથા susceptible stress/materialથી crack બને; તે uniform metal loss કે scaleથી જુદું છે.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. પહેલાં deposition, metal loss, carryover કે cracking ઓળખો; એક chemical ચારેય માટે cure છે એવું ન માનો.
  2. યોગ્ય combinationમાં external treatment, deaeration/internal chemistry, level-load control, blowdown તથા qualified inspection લો.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Sections સમજણ માટે છે, actual boilerનું failure-proof નથી. Student opening, chemical cleaning કે pressure-part repair સૂચવેલ નથી.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Scale heating surface પર adherent deposit છે; sludge loose/removable છે. Scale heat-transfer ઘટાડીને metal overheat કરે; external/internal treatment તથા blowdown complementary છે.
  • Corrosion chemical/electrochemical material degradation છે; oxygen pitting/CO2 condensate corrosion માટે gas-chemistry control તથા monitoring/material practice જોઈએ.
  • Priming એટલે steam સાથે water droplets; foaming persistent froth છે જે carryover વધારે. High level/load change/TDS/oil કારણ બને; level-load/chemistry/separation control કરો.
  • Caustic embrittlement susceptible stressed/local-concentration conditions માં caustic-related cracking છે; દર alkaline water દરેક steel ને crack કરતું નથી; local concentration અટકાવી qualified programme રાખો.

ઉપયોગ તથા Applications

  • Pretreatment/deaeration/conditioning/blowdown/maintenance પસંદ કરતાં પહેલાં actual mechanism ઓળખો.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Pressurised boiler ન ખોલો, safety device adjust/unsupervised chemical cleaning ન કરો; આ study છે, operation authority નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Screening retains large floating or suspended matter using openings selected for the intake/service; it is a preliminary physical barrier.

Classification / comparison

  • Bar/coarse screens and finer mesh/screens; manual or mechanically cleaned arrangements as appropriate.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Coarse and fine screens differ in opening size and cleaning requirements; mechanical screening does not remove dissolved hardness, salts or all microbes.

Labelled diagram

Bar screen: what is retained and what passes

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Channel directs incoming water toward the screen; the screened stream continues downstream rather than through a chemical reaction.
  2. 2 Bars/openings physically intercept material larger than the relevant gaps; angle/support and cleaning arrangements follow the actual design.
  3. 3 Coarse debris stays on the upstream face and can increase head loss if allowed to accumulate.
  4. 4 Outlet carries screened water that still needs the next barriers for fine particles, dissolved matter and microbes.
  5. 5 Rake/collection bin indicates separate removal of screenings; it is not a product collection point.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Follow water through the openings while oversized debris remains behind. Follow the brown cleaning arrow upward to collection.
  2. Cleaning restores available open area; it does not regenerate a chemical resin or disinfect the water.

Important limit: Never reach into a working screen/rake. Screening is preliminary physical treatment, not a drinking-water safety certificate.

Construction / parts

  1. Frame and bars/mesh provide the physical openings; channel/support guides raw flow through rather than around the screen.
  2. Rake/cleaning device, screenings collection and differential-level/head-loss indication support continued service.

Working / process sequence

  1. Feed passes through openings while oversized debris is retained.
  2. Accumulated screenings increase resistance; clean at the designed trigger without putting hands into moving machinery.
  3. Dispose retained waste safely and send screened water to the next treatment barrier.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Intake/service મુજબના openings થી મોટા floating/suspended solids અટકાવતું preliminary physical barrier screening છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Bar/coarse તથા finer mesh screens; manual/mechanical cleaning service મુજબ.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Coarse/fine screens ના openings/cleaning જુદાં છે; screening dissolved hardness/salts કે બધા microbes દૂર નથી કરતું.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Bar Screen: શું અટકે અને શું પસાર થાય?

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Channel incoming waterને screen તરફ લાવે; screened water downstream જાય છે, અહીં chemical reaction નથી.
  2. 2 Bars/openings gaps કરતાં મોટું relevant material અટકાવે છે; angle/support/cleaning actual design પ્રમાણે હોય છે.
  3. 3 Coarse debris upstream face પર અટકે અને જમા થાય તો head loss વધારે છે.
  4. 4 Outletનું screened water હજી fine particles, dissolved matter તથા microbes માટે next barriers માંગે છે.
  5. 5 Rake/bin screenings અલગ કાઢવાનું બતાવે છે; તે product-water collection point નથી.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Water openingsમાંથી પસાર થાય જ્યારે મોટું debris અટકે છે; cleaningનો brown arrow ઉપર collection તરફ વાંચો.
  2. Cleaningથી opening area પાછું મળે; તે resin regeneration કે water disinfection નથી.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Working screen/rakeમાં હાથ ન નાખો. Screening preliminary physical treatment છે, potable certificate નહીં.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Frame/bar/mesh openings બનાવે; channel/support flow ને screen માંથી લઈ જાય, bypass થી નહીં.
  2. Rake/cleaning, screenings collection/head-loss indication service જાળવે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Feed openings માંથી જાય અને મોટું debris અટકે.
  2. Debris થી resistance વધે; designed trigger એ clean કરો, moving machinery માં હાથ નહીં.
  3. Waste safe રીતે કાઢી water ને next barrier માં મોકલો.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Sedimentation separates particles whose settling behaviour and hydraulic conditions permit gravity removal within the treatment tank.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • For suitable dilute discrete settling, the surface overflow rate Q/Ais an important comparison with particle settling velocity; detention time alone does not guarantee removal.
  • Short-circuiting, turbulence, density currents and sludge buildup reduce useful performance; colloids may not settle adequately without coagulation/flocculation.

Labelled diagram

Settling tank: three different directions

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Inlet brings suspended solids with the feed.
  2. 2 Baffle distributes flow and reduces disruptive inlet momentum, helping prevent a direct short path to the outlet.
  3. 3 Settling zone provides the required area/hydraulics; water crosses horizontally while settleable particles move downward.
  4. 4 Weir/overflow collects clarified upper water; it does not collect the sludge from the bottom.
  5. 5 Hopper/outlet collects and removes settled solids separately to limit sludge buildup and carryover.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Blue horizontal arrows show the water path; brown downward arrows show settling; the brown bottom line shows sludge withdrawal.
  2. A clearer outlet does not imply removal of dissolved salts or complete microbe control; further barriers may still be required.

Important limit: For suitable settling models, Q/A is surface overflow rate, not the same quantity as V/Q detention time. Actual geometry/solids decide performance.

Construction / parts

  1. Inlet baffle distributes flow; settling zone provides area and calm flow; outlet weirs collect clarified water.
  2. Bottom hopper/scraper and sludge withdrawal remove settled solids without disturbing clarification.

Working / process sequence

  1. Distribute feed and reduce disruptive inlet velocity.
  2. Allow settleable particles to move down while water crosses the tank.
  3. Collect clarified water, withdraw sludge and monitor carryover/hydraulics.

Worked example

  1. For Q100m3/h and area50m2, overflow rate=2m/h; this calculation alone does not certify actual particle removal.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Particle settling તથા tank hydraulics યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે gravity થી solids અલગ કરવાની sedimentation છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Suitable dilute discrete settling માં Q/A surface overflow rate મહત્વનું છે; માત્ર detention time થી removal guarantee નથી.
  • Short-circuit, turbulence, density currents/sludge performance ઘટાડે; colloids ને coagulation વગર પૂરતું settling ન મળે.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Settling Tank: ત્રણ જુદી દિશાઓ

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Inlet feed સાથે suspended solids લાવે છે.
  2. 2 Baffle flow વહેંચીને inlet momentum ઘટાડે છે જેથી inletથી outlet સુધી short-circuit ન બને.
  3. 3 Settling zone જરૂરી area/hydraulics આપે; water આડું આગળ જાય અને settleable particles નીચે જાય છે.
  4. 4 Weir/overflow ઉપરનું clarified water લે છે; bottom sludge લેતું નથી.
  5. 5 Hopper/outlet settled solids અલગ ભેગાં/દૂર કરે જેથી buildup/carryover ઘટે.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Blue horizontal arrows water flow, brown downward arrows settling અને bottom brown line sludge withdrawal બતાવે છે.
  2. Clearer outletથી salts કે બધા microbes દૂર થયા એવું નથી; આગળના barriers જરૂરી હોઈ શકે.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Q/A surface overflow rate છે, V/Q detention timeથી જુદું છે; actual geometry/solidsથી performance નક્કી થાય.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Inlet baffle flow વહેંચે, settling zone area/calm flow આપે, outlet weirs clarified water લે.
  2. Hopper/scraper/sludge withdrawal solids કાઢે, clarification disturb કર્યા વગર.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Feed distribute કરીને inlet turbulence ઘટાડો.
  2. Water tank પાર જાય ત્યારે particles ને નીચે settle થવા દો.
  3. Clarified water collect/sludge કાઢી carryover/hydraulics monitor કરો.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ

  1. Q100m3/h/A50m2 થી overflow rate2m/h; આથી actual particle removal certify થતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

Coagulation destabilises colloids; flocculation uses controlled gentle contact to form larger separable aggregates after destabilisation.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Fine colloids may remain dispersed because of surface charge/stability; appropriate coagulants neutralise/destabilise or form sweep flocs under suitable pH/alkalinity.
  • Alum and iron-salt treatments consume/alter alkalinity and produce sludge; the best dose is water-specific. Ajar-test study compares conditions instead of assuming a universal dose.

Labelled diagram

Rapid mix versus gentle floc growth

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Reagent preparation/feed supplies the water-specific selected coagulant; no universal alum dose is shown.
  2. 2 Rapid mixer distributes coagulant quickly to destabilise colloids under the suitable pH/alkalinity conditions.
  3. 3 Gentle compartments promote particle contact and floc growth without unnecessary breakup. The shaft sketches identify mixing devices, not identical required mixer speeds.
  4. 4 Outlet leads to settling/filter separation; making flocs and removing flocs are separate operations.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Raw water first meets the rapidly distributed chemical, then enters lower-shear flocculation. The drawn aggregates become separable solids for a later barrier.
  2. If rapid/gentle stages are confused, poor reagent distribution or broken flocs can result even when the chemical itself is appropriate.

Important limit: Chemical/pH selection and dose need qualified tests. A student sketch or visual floc observation is not potability validation.

Construction / parts

  1. Rapid-mix tank introduces reagent quickly; flocculator supplies lower controlled shear; clarifier/filter subsequently removes aggregates.

Working / process sequence

  1. Determine suitable coagulant/pH/dose from qualified testing and raw-water quality.
  2. Disperse reagent rapidly to destabilise particles before uneven local treatment occurs.
  3. Apply gentle mixing to grow flocs; excessive shear can break them.
  4. Separate flocs and verify turbidity/pH/sludge behaviour; coagulant residuals also need control.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Chemical selection/dosing requires qualified supervision; student process sketches do not make treated water potable.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Coagulation colloids destabilise કરે; પછી controlled gentle contact થી મોટા separable flocs બનાવવું flocculation છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Surface charge/stability થી colloids dispersed રહે; appropriate coagulant suitable pH/alkalinity માં destabilise/charge neutralise અથવા sweep floc બનાવે.
  • Alum/iron salts alkalinity બદલે/વાપરે અને sludge બનાવે; best dose water-specific છે; jar-test થી compare કરો, universal dose નહીં.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Rapid Mix તથા Gentle Floc Growth

Diagramના નંબરો પ્રમાણે ભાગોની સમજણ

  1. 1 Reagent feed water-specific coagulant આપે છે; universal alum dose બતાવેલ નથી.
  2. 2 Rapid mixer suitable pH/alkalinityમાં coagulant ઝડપથી વહેંચી colloids destabilise કરે છે.
  3. 3 Gentle compartments contact/floc growth વધારે અને breakup ઘટાડે; shaft sketches mixers ઓળખાવે છે, એકસરખી speed સૂચવતા નથી.
  4. 4 Outlet settling/filter તરફ જાય છે; flocs બનાવવું અને દૂર કરવું જુદાં operations છે.

Working:Arrows પ્રમાણે Flow વાંચો

  1. Raw water પહેલાં rapidly distributed chemical સાથે મળે, પછી lower-shear flocculationમાં જાય; aggregates આગળ અલગ કરી શકાય તેવા solids બને છે.
  2. બંને stages ગૂંચવાય તો યોગ્ય chemical હોવા છતાં poor distribution અથવા floc breakup થઈ શકે.

મહત્વની મર્યાદા: Chemical, pH/dose માટે qualified tests જોઈએ; student sketch/visual floc observation potable validation નથી.

રચના તથા મુખ્ય ભાગો

  1. Rapid mixer reagent ઝડપથી વહેંચે; flocculator controlled low shear આપે; પછી clarifier/filter aggregates કાઢે.

કાર્યપદ્ધતિ / પ્રક્રિયાનો ક્રમ

  1. Qualified testing/raw quality થી coagulant, pH/dose નક્કી કરો.
  2. Reagent ઝડપથી વહેંચીને uneven local treatment પહેલાં destabilise કરો.
  3. Gentle mixing થી floc grow કરો; વધુ shear તેને તોડી શકે.
  4. Flocs separate કરી turbidity, pH/sludge તથા coagulant residual verify કરો.

મર્યાદા, સલામતી તથા સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Chemical selection/dosing qualified supervision થી; student sketch થી પાણી potable નથી બનતું.

body.en:
Definition / meaning

A granular filter passes water through a specified porous medium to capture remaining particles by multiple transport/attachment mechanisms.

Classification / comparison

  • Slow sand versus rapid granular; gravity versus pressure service are another independent classification.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Capture occurs through interception, settling, attachment and other mechanisms; filter performance depends on media, loading, pretreatment and ripening, not pore size alone.
  • Slow-sand filters use low loading and a developed biological surface layer; cleaning may remove the top layer. Rapid granular filters use higher loading with suitable pretreatment and designed backwash.

Labelled diagram

Rapid filter: service direction and alternative wash

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Clarified feed enters above the media, not directly into the final filtered-water line.
  2. 2 Sand/selected granular media captures remaining particles by the appropriate filtration mechanisms.
  3. 3 Support gravel supports the selected bed and helps distribute/collect flow; media design is plant-specific.
  4. 4 Underdrain collects filtered water while retaining bed material.
  5. 5 Service outlet is the solid-blue product path; head loss and outlet quality are monitored.
  6. 6 Alternative wash/waste route sends suitable clean wash water upward to dislodge retained matter and removes dirty wash water above the bed.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. In normal downflow service, follow blue arrows1→2→3→4→5.Particles accumulate, so resistance and possibly breakthrough change with use.
  2. Dashed orange arrows depict another mode: cleaning/backwash, not an instruction to mix service product with wash waste. Return to service only after the approved recovery/quality checks.

Important limit: Do not copy a valve sequence or expansion rate from this schematic. Filtration does not generally remove dissolved salts and is not complete disinfection.

Labelled diagram

Slow-sand filter: why the upper layer matters

Numbered parts:match these with the diagram

  1. 1 Feed is distributed above the bed without disrupting the developed surface.
  2. 2 Supernatant water provides a water layer above the bed; its depth/control belongs to the actual design.
  3. 3 Developed biological surface contributes to treatment in a properly matured slow-sand filter. It is not a layer that makes any new sand bottle instantly safe.
  4. 4 Fine sand provides the granular treatment depth; 5 support/underdrain retains media and collects filtered flow.
  5. 6 Outlet carries the monitored filtrate to the required next protection/disinfection/storage barriers.

Working:follow the arrows

  1. Blue arrows show downflow through the developed surface and sand to collection. Cleaning may involve controlled surface removal/scraping according to design.
  2. Slow-sand loading, biological action and cleaning differ from rapid filtration; the two drawings must not be given an identical backwash explanation.

Important limit: Maturation, temperature, feed quality and flow affect performance; no household-water potability claim is made.

Construction / parts

  1. Vessel/basin, inlet distributor, selected media layers, support gravel/underdrain, outlet and head-loss/turbidity monitoring.
  2. Rapid filters have engineered wash-water/air-scour paths where designed; slow-sand cleaning should not be copied from a rapid-filter manual.

Working / process sequence

  1. Feed suitable clarified water uniformly and maintain designed loading.
  2. Particles accumulate and head loss rises; monitor effluent breakthrough as well as head loss.
  3. Clean using the filter-specific method, handle dirty wash water and verify return-to-service quality.

Limitations, safety and common errors

  • Granular filtration does not generally remove dissolved salts or prove complete pathogen control; disinfection/other barriers remain necessary.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Specified porous granular medium માંથી water પસાર કરી transport/attachment mechanisms થી particles પકડવાની granular filtration છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / સરખામણી

  • Slow sand/rapid granular; gravity/pressure service અલગ classification છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • Interception, settling, attachment વગેરેથી capture થાય; media, loading, pretreatment/ripening મહત્વનાં છે, માત્ર pore size નહીં.
  • Slow-sand low loading/biological surface વાપરે અને top-layer cleaning થાય; rapid filter higher loading, pretreatment/backwash વાપરે.

Labelled Diagram / નામવાળી આકૃતિ

Definition / meaning

Stoichiometric reagent demand is the theoretical chemical quantity derived from balanced reactions, before practical excess, purity and side demands are applied.

Principle and detailed explanation

  • Use a common CaCO3basis and identify calcium/magnesium and carbonate/noncarbonate contributions before dosing calculations.

Assumptions and ordered calculation

  1. Assume100mg/L calcium carbonate hardness, 50mg/L magnesium carbonate hardness and40mg/L calcium noncarbonate hardness, all as CaCO3.No extra CO2/acidity demand.
  2. Pure Ca(OH)2demand=(74/100)(100+2×50)=148mg/L; the factor2comes from magnesium bicarbonate reaction.
  3. Pure Na2CO3demand=(106/100)×40=42.4mg/L.Mgcarbonate hardness does not create an extra soda demand in this balanced case.
  4. For10m3water, chemical kg=dose(mg/L)×volume(m3)/1000.Pure lime=1.48kg; soda=0.424kg.
  5. At80%lime and90%soda purity, purchased quantities=1.48/0.80=1.85kg and0.424/0.90=0.4711kg, excluding practical excess.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / અર્થ

Balanced reactions પરથી મળતી theoretical chemical quantity ને stoichiometric demand કહે છે; પછી purity, practical excess તથા side demands લાગુ પડે છે.

સિદ્ધાંત તથા વિગતવાર સમજણ

  • પહેલાં hardness ને CaCO3 basis પર ફેરવી Ca/Mg તથા carbonate/noncarbonate parts ઓળખો.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ ગણતરી

  1. Ca carbonate100, Mg carbonate50 તથા Ca noncarbonate40mg/L as CaCO3 લો; extra CO2/acidity demand નથી.
  2. Pure Ca(OH)2=(74/100)(100+2×50)=148mg/L; Mg bicarbonate reaction થી factor2 આવે છે.
  3. Pure Na2CO3=(106/100)×40=42.4mg/L; આ balanced case માં Mg carbonate માટે વધારાનું soda નથી.
  4. 10m3 માટે kg=dose mg/L×m3/1000; lime1.48kg/soda0.424kg.
  5. Purity80%/90% હોય તો purchased lime1.85kg/soda0.4711kg; practical excess સામેલ નથી.
